findings.location: HTML, item 3 in the numbered list; commentary following Malaki 2:14–16
findings.source_quote: To raise up a godly seed unto the Lord.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the phrase with “Ili wamlee Bwana uzao unaomcha Mungu.” → “Ili wamlee Bwana uzao unaomcha Mungu” is ambiguous; use “Ili wamlee Bwana watoto wanaomcha Mungu” only if the intended meaning is raising children for the Lord, or more directly “Ili wazao wao wamche Mungu.”
findings.translation_quote: Ili wamlee Bwana uzao unaomcha Mungu.
